question: Where is fast food restaurant situated within 10 kilometers in the direction of Fairview Park, Ennis, TX from LEGOLAND Discovery Center Dallas/Fort Worth, Grapevine, TX?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%LEGOLAND Discovery Center Dallas/Fort Worth%' LIMIT 1 ), target AS ( SELECT p.geometry AS geom FROM parks p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Fairview Park%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, (SELECT r.geometry FROM regions r WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Ennis%' AND r.border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), bearing_calc AS ( SELECT o.geom AS origin_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geom::geography, t.geom::geography)) AS target_bearing_deg FROM origin o, target t ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, bearing_calc bc WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, bc.origin_geom::geography, 10000) -- within 10 km (10000 meters) AND ABS( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(bc.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - bc.target_bearing_deg + 180 + 360) % 360 - 180 ) <= 22.5; -- within +/- 22.5 degrees of the target bearing (a 45-degree cone)
